text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—The final race of the Classic Triple Crown.
The Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I had once removed it from my goals,
yet to think I would actually get to run in it."
choice_data_list: Glad the adjustments were finished in time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Even so, I am currently working hard toward a new goal.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I won't obsess over the Triple Crown races.
Nor will I view them as anything special. What I aim for is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will deliver results just as always. That is all.
